items.text_th: สอบถามนะคะ ถ้าสมมุติว่าน้องติดสถานะมากกว่า 1 สถานะ ค่าตัวน้องจะคิดราคาบวกเพิ่มตาม% ของทุกสถานะมั้ยคะ สมมติถ้าติด เปียกชื้น +10% สายรุ้ง +100% แสงทอง +200% ค่าตัวน้องจะบวกทั้งหมด 310% เลยไหมคะ หรือว่าต้องคิดยังไง

items.text_en: Question: if a tree has more than one effect, does its price add up the % of every effect? E.g. damp +10%, rainbow +100%, golden light +200% — is that +310% total, or is it calculated differently?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi giá cây có cộng dồn % khi dính nhiều hiệu ứng không.
items.summary_en: Asks whether price bonuses stack when a tree has several effects.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: [redacted] เค้าลงตอนไฟช็อตค่ะ อยากได้สักต้นให้ติด แต่ไม่ติดช็อตเลย นอย
items.text_vn: [redacted] Mình trồng lúc thời tiết điện giật, muốn ít nhất một cây dính mà chẳng cây nào dính hiệu ứng điện giật, buồn ghê.
items.text_en: [redacted] I planted during the electric-shock weather hoping at least one would get it, but none got the shock effect. Bummed.
items.summary_vn: Buồn vì trồng lúc điện giật mà không cây nào dính hiệu ứng.
items.summary_en: Disappointed no tree got the shock effect.

items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: [redacted] ขอบคุณมากค่ะ. ไว้เดียวไปลองค่ะ
items.text_vn: [redacted] Cảm ơn nhiều ạ, để lát mình thử.
items.text_en: [redacted] Thanks a lot, I'll try it later.
items.summary_vn: Cảm ơn hướng dẫn qua mép bản đồ.
items.summary_en: Thanks someone for the tip.

items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: [redacted] ขอบคุณค่ะได้แล้วค่ะ

items.text_en: [redacted] Thanks, it works now.

items.summary_en: Says they got the game back thanks to the tip.
items.theme: Đăng nhập tài khoản
items.topic: Login / Account / Data

items.text_th: [redacted] ใช่ครับต้องเรียนรู้ใหม่หมดเลยเกมพัฒนาหลายๆอย่างเพิ่มมาเยอะมากเมื่อก่อนวนๆอยู่แต่ขุดหินกับตกปลาเลยเลิกเล่นไปหลายรอบเดะต้องลองเปิดใจดูก่อนครับ
items.text_vn: [redacted] Đúng rồi, phải học lại hết. Game cải tiến thêm nhiều thứ lắm, hồi trước chỉ quanh quẩn đào đá với câu cá nên mình bỏ mấy lần. Chắc phải thử mở lòng chơi lại xem.
items.text_en: [redacted] Yeah, I'll have to relearn everything. The game added so much — back then it was just mining and fishing on repeat so I quit a few times. I'll give it an open mind.
items.summary_vn: Người chơi cũ thấy game thêm nhiều nội dung, muốn thử quay lại.
items.summary_en: Returning player notes lots of new content and will give it a try.
items.theme: Trải nghiệm game tích cực
items.topic: Other

items.text_th: ได้อยู่นะ
items.text_vn: Cũng được đó.
items.text_en: It's alright.
items.summary_vn: Cho rằng game vẫn ổn để chơi.
items.summary_en: Says the game is still alright.
items.theme: Trải nghiệm game tích cực
items.topic: Other

items.text_th: ผมว่าสนุกกว่าเดิมนะครับ มีฟังก์ชั่นใหม่ๆเยอะแยะเลย
items.text_vn: Mình thấy vui hơn trước đó, có nhiều tính năng mới lắm.
items.text_en: I think it's more fun than before — there are lots of new features.
items.summary_vn: Khen game vui hơn trước nhờ nhiều tính năng mới.
items.summary_en: Says the game is more fun now with many new features.
items.theme: Trải nghiệm game tích cực
items.topic: Other

items.text_th: [redacted] ผมปล่อยตัวเวลตันเลยอ่ะครับ เห็นเพิ่มสถานะแต่ไม่รู้เพิ่มจริงไหม
items.text_vn: [redacted] Mình thả con max level luôn, thấy ghi là tăng hiệu ứng mà không biết có tăng thật không.
items.text_en: [redacted] I released a max-level one; it says it boosts effects but I'm not sure it really does.
items.summary_vn: Không chắc thú thả nông trại có tăng hiệu ứng thật không.

items.text_vn: [redacted] Con max level thì đem ra dùng, con nuôi trong vườn là con chưa max level.
items.text_en: [redacted] Take the max-level ones out to use; the ones in the garden are those not maxed yet.
items.summary_vn: Giải thích thú max level nên mang theo, thú chưa max thì thả vườn.
items.summary_en: Explains max-level pets are used, unmaxed ones go in the garden.

items.text_vn: [redacted] Hay quá, tiết kiệm tiền, nuôi thú 700x4.
items.text_en: [redacted] Love it — saves money, raising pets 700x4.

items.text_th: ตกปลาครับพลาซ่ากับเกาะรีสอท มันจะมีวงสีม่วงๆ สุ่มเกิดตอนนาที่00 กับ30 ของเวลาจริงมันจะเป็นปลาพิเศษที่พบได้เฉพาะในวง เอาไปแลกที่หม้อกิจกรรม
items.text_vn: Câu cá đó bạn, ở quảng trường với đảo resort. Sẽ có vòng màu tím xuất hiện ngẫu nhiên vào phút 00 và 30 theo giờ thật, trong vòng có cá đặc biệt, đem đổi ở nồi sự kiện.
items.text_en: Fishing — at the plaza and resort island. Purple circles spawn randomly at :00 and :30 real time; special fish only appear inside them. Trade them at the event pot.
items.summary_vn: Hướng dẫn câu cá sự kiện ở vòng tím phút 00/30 để đổi xu.
items.summary_en: Explains event fishing in purple circles at :00/:30 to get coins.
items.theme: Phần thưởng sự kiện
items.topic: Event & Update content

items.text_th: อยากกลับไปโหลดเลย
